newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish shares post losses on n.Iraqi fighting.
newsitem.headline: Turkish shares post losses on n.Iraqi fighting.

text.p: Istanbul shares extended morning losses in thin afternoon trade on Monday amid caution and negative mood produced by Iraq's weekend military action in Kurdish-held northern Iraq, brokers said.

"Today's uneasiness was due to the Iraqi fighting although all earlier (technical) indicators were in favour of the bourse. There is anxiety because the fighting may spread and the U.S. may intervene," said Semih Cetin, general manager of Bayindir securities.

The IKMB-100 closed at 63,275.86, down 1,257.51 points, or 1.95 percent from Thursday. Turkish markets were closed for a holiday on Friday. It brushed a low of 63,045 in the afternoon following a 1.66 percent drop to 63,464.46 in the morning.
Daily trade volume shrank to 4.3 trillion lira ($49.3 million) from Thursday's 6.2 trillion ($72.3 million).
Brokers said the market also awaited the Treasury's 112-day t-bill auction on Tuesday after the average yield went up sharply in last week's 189-day t-bill auction.
